alex (Docs): quick sync: i'm polishing the Optimize toolkit migration guide. noticed a couple of issues in the batch/cache/quant snippets that slipped through review. can we tidy before i merge?
june (DevEx): drop examples here and i'll smoke-test in the samples repo.
alex (Docs): two problematic bits: 1) the ruby snippet uses `Batch.new` which our ruby SDK no longer exposes, 2) the quant profile table claims q8_0 is always "recommended" which is misleading for instruction-following workloads.
kai (Runtime): correct on Batch.new — ruby should use `client.batch.request(inputs:, max_tokens:)`. also add a short note about batching latency for short-sequence workloads: prefer smaller max_batch_size or explicit burst routes.
miriam (ML): re: quant note, please change language to "cost-savvy but evaluate" and add a tiny eval-ctr snippet recommending 100 sample prompts for generation vs 1000 for embeddings.
kb-bot: docs-link-check: broken internal link found -> /docs/sdk/ruby/batch (404) :warning:
june (DevEx): here's what i tested locally. ruby replacement snippet:
```ruby
resp = client.batch.request(inputs: [prompt], max_tokens: 256)
puts resp.text
```
plus a one-line prefetch example for workloads with repeated prefixes:
```py
# prefetch for repeated prefixes
client.cache.prefetch(["session_prefix_v2"])
res = client.generate(model: "redwood/fast-ggml", prompt: prompt)
```
alex (Docs): perfect. i'll reword the quant table header and add miriam's eval recommendations as a footnote. also fixing that ruby link target to /docs/sdk/ruby/reference/batch_request.
kai (Runtime): small FYI: for short-seq chat style usage, recommend `max_batch_latency_ms: 20` or use per-route low-latency policy to avoid batching-induced tail latency. add that as a callout so users don't accidentally increase p99.
miriam (ML): added a one-liner to the PR comments about q4_0 vs q8_0: q4_0 preserves token-level fidelity better for generation; q8_0 can be fine for dense embeddings but check for embedding drift on your dataset.
june (DevEx): i fixed the broken link in the branch and pushed the snippet tweaks (PR #701). ci-bot: docs-lint passed for #701 :white_check_mark:
alex (Docs): merging after i update the changelog "Optimize: clarify quant guidance + fix SDK snippets". thanks everyone — closing thread. :tada:
